name: Guy Victor Molinari
desc: former United States Representative and borough president of Staten Island, New York (1928-2018)
summary: Gaetano Victor Molinari (November 23, 1928 – July 25, 2018) was an American lawyer and Republican politician from New York City. He represented Staten Island in the United States House of Representatives for four terms (1981–1989), and then served 12 years as Staten Island borough president (1990–2002). His daughter, Susan Molinari, also served as a U.S. representative.
